title: Release Apache Iceberg Terraform provider v0.1.0 RC1
summary: zeroshade proposed release candidate 1 of the Apache Iceberg Terraform provider v0.1.0, based on commit ce85caf0, with convenience binaries for the Terraform and OpenTofu registries attached to a GitHub prerelease. sungwy, rambleraptor and Rich Bowen voted +1 after verifying signatures, checksums and license files; two of them also built from source and ran the tests. kevinjqliu then reported a schema-validation problem he considered a release blocker: on table creation, omitted field IDs are serialized as 0, so the published example sends duplicate field IDs and the catalog rejects it; on table update, the provider does not check Iceberg schema evolution rules and committed a long-to-string change and an optional-to-required change. He also noted leftover 'polaris' references and a 1.0.0 version in build.sh. zeroshade said he would fix the issues and cut a new RC.

positions.stance: The release should wait until the provider submits schemas with unique field IDs on create and rejects table updates that are not valid Iceberg schema evolutions.
Will look into fixing the reported issues and cut a new release candidate when done.

outcome.note: The release manager said he would fix the reported schema issues and cut a new RC. Votes cast before that: one +1 binding and two +1 non-binding.

why_it_matters: The first Terraform provider release is held back until table schemas are created with valid field IDs and incompatible schema changes are rejected.
